For the cosmetic pets in Dungeons II, see MCD2:Pet (cosmetic).
Not to be confused with MCD:Pet (summonable).

The term cosmetic pet refers to the cosmetic mobs that provide no functional benefits to the hero. All available cosmetics are obtainable only by the purchase of DLC packs, the completion of the Adventure Passes and the completion of in-game events.

They are equipable from the cosmetics page of the inventory.

Behavior

Cosmetic pets are non-attackable mobs that move alongside the hero, teleporting when too far, and ignores other mobs. Pets, like other mobs, are able to activate the pressure plates of traps in the environment, such as those in Desert Temple, and have a very rare chance to drop consumables, armor, and weapons upon falling off the map. These are not to be confused with Summons that can interact with mobs.

Trivia

  • In series of twitter posts, a pet parade vote took place.[5]
    • In the first round of voting, the arctic fox won against the baby turtle, baby pig, and the endermite.[6]
    • In the second round of voting, the baby ghast won against the baby goat, baby chicken, and the parrot.[7]
    • In the final round of voting, the baby ghast won against the arctic fox.[8]
